description:
Refactor the 'MRISliceCache' class in the 'MedicalImagingSystem' project to prevent OutOfMemory errors. 

The current implementation uses a standard HashMap which grows indefinitely as MRI slices are loaded. You must:
1. Open the project 'MedicalImagingSystem' (located in ~/eclipse-workspace/).
2. Modify 'src/main/java/com/medsys/imaging/MRISliceCache.java' to use a 'LinkedHashMap' with an LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction policy.
3. The cache must hold a MAXIMUM of 20 slices.
4. Ensure the 'CacheStabilityTest' passes when run via Maven or Eclipse JUnit runner.

Note: The 'removeEldestEntry' method of LinkedHashMap is commonly used for this purpose.
